description: This file defines the ChaosAgentCommand class, which is a command-line command for orchestrating server shutdowns or restarts with configurable parameters, including messaging via channels and logging.

classes.name: ChaosAgentCommand
classes.description: A command-line command class for managing chaos testing operations such as server restart and shutdown, with configurable options.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: A nested class representing the parameters for the ChaosAgentCommand, including service and cluster identifiers, URIs, timing, and flags for graceful restart and restart actions.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method executing the chaos command logic: creating communication channels, sending messages in rounds, and logging progress.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Local function within RunAsync that generates a list of server messages based on current parameters.
